notes.title: UPDATE on Release Date
notes.notes:
[b]Hi there! Betetiro here.[/b]

[i]I've got some great news – we've completed the localizations for the[/i] [b]Turkish and Japanese[/b] [i]versions[/i]! It's really exciting because now people from all around the world can enjoy our game, thanks to our amazing volunteers!

[h4]I'm incredibly thankful for their help. The Turkish translation was done by Arda Özükurt and Anıl Yılmaz. The Japanese translation was done by [url=https://nicolith.crd.co]nicolith[/url].[/h4]

Currently, I'm integrating the Japanese translation into the game, while the Turkish and English versions are all set. [b]Sounds cool, doesn’t it? I thought so too.[/b]

Now, let's talk about what we've achieved and the challenges we've faced. Our testers discovered quite a few bugs during testing, both major issues and minor errors. It took a considerable amount of time to address and fix these, as I want to ensure you have a flawless gaming experience and am committed to not releasing the game before it’s ready. Initially, I was optimistic about a mid-January release, but as I sit here, I realize my caution about potential bugs and issues was warranted. [b]Therefore, the game is now set to be published in February. I hope this doesn't disappoint you; I'm doing my best to deliver the game as soon as possible![/b] [i]I can’t specify an exact release date right now, as I don't want to commit to a date and then potentially face delays due to unforeseen errors.[/i] [b]Rest assured, I will announce the date once the game is fully polished and ready with all the promised localizations.[/b]

I've also added some fun achievements and have already tested them!
And yeah, watch this
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43957091/83ab928196f7dad52aeecc74c39c939642d8335b.png[/img]

[h4]I really wish I could publish the game as soon as possible and see your feedback—I truly do![/h4]

Oh, and I almost forgot to mention that I've added new endings. [b]Now, there will be 7 endings in total, plus 1 secret ending (which you'll unlock after completing the 5 most crucial endings) that will explain the game and what I really wanted to share with you through this story.[/b] So, I guess this is goodbye for now, but I'll definitely be back next time with the release date. [i]Your support inspires me to keep going and not give up. I'm so grateful for everyone who's waiting for the game. I'm also looking forward to hearing your feedback.[/i]

[b]Hope to see you soon! Thank you, and have a great day. Take care, and I wish you all the best![/b]

notes.title: Release Date Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

I'm betetiro, the one behind Hazy Mind. Super excited to tell you that we're [i]almost done with the full release![/i]

We've [b]finished about 85%[/b] of it, and the release date is just around the corner! I'm thinking we might wrap up [b]by mid or end of January 2024[/b]. Could be February too, if we run into bugs or other issues, but that's the plan!

Oh, and I've just updated the trailer on our page. Have you seen it yet? If not, check it out here:
[previewyoutube=2x-oWwQ8Obc;full][/previewyoutube]

Would love to hear what you think, so drop a comment or hit the like button!

The full game will have [b]20k words,[/b] [b]a mini-game[/b], [b]and 5 different endings.[/b] [i]Sounds cool, right? I thought so!
[/i]
Sorry for not posting many updates here. I'll fix that and keep you in the loop with every step towards our release. Also, come [b]join our Discord server[/b]. We're a friendly bunch and love sharing memes!

[b]Link:[/b] https://discord.gg/chCAecgpMh

And here, [b]take a look at some screenshots from the full release[/b]. Hope you find them exciting!
